ruling70.note: Owner ruling 70 (2026-10-05): the three swiss_knockout R4 cells whose Swiss round 5 pairs nobody under the product's lots tiebreak (a UUID-hashed draw, by design) flip between works and red across runs (P6, audit SW-H1, routed to W3). The baseline records them RED whatever the committed run showed: a later works on them reads as an improvement and a later red as no change. judge regression applies this list to the baseline it is given, and only to the run it was written for (workflowRun, tag, tagCommit: the committed L3 must be that run, or the block is refused). The SW-H1 fix removes this block and re-baselines L3. W2e Task 35 re-baselined L3 to the W2e truth run's CI L3 (the W1d baseline predates the 3x15 badminton default, so the PR sample's badminton ids had no baseline twin) and carried this block forward by hand, with the new run's provenance: workflow run 40874582041, dispatched on branch feat/format-matrix-w2e-b (no tag was cut), at the harness commit below. The ruling and its three ids are unchanged; the W1d record that justifies them is truth-runs/w1d-baseline.
